args.query: violent crime homicide city police agency murder counts

sql: SELECT a.agency_name, r."year", SUM(r.actual_murder) AS murders FROM crime.cde_reta r JOIN crime.cde_agencies a ON a.ori LIKE r.ori || '%' OR r.ori = a.ori WHERE a.agency_name IN ('New York City Police Department','Chicago Police Department','Memphis Police Department','Philadelphia Police Department') AND r."year" IN (2025,2026) AND r."month" BETWEEN 1 AND 9 GROUP BY a.agency_name, r."year" ORDER BY 1,2
